entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A free-spirited, impulsive and incredibly powerful fire-conjuring planeswalker still growing into the hero she is destined to become.

events.summary: Chandra tends to act first and think later when faced with a challenge, and cannot stand aside when confronted by oppression.
events.quote: when faced with a challenge, she tends to act first and think later.
